title: transformer-observation
description: Per-role observation schema for a transformer record at code/transformers/<gerund>.md. The required fields are the ones the harness reads: name, gerund, imperative, agent-noun, description. Categorical fields (category, domain, codomain) are SHOULD per the transformer spec but are body-described in much of the existing corpus, so they remain optional in the schema until the corpus carries them in frontmatter.

name.description: Kebab-case gerund of the transformer's verb. Equals the filename stem and the gerund field.

imperative.description: The bare-verb form used to derive skill script filenames: scripts/<imperative>-<rest>.mjs.

agent-noun.description: The English deverbal agent-noun form (writer, auditor, dispatcher).
